text: Implemented FreeSurferAseg shared descriptor and AsegLoader JVM entry point with neuroatlas bundled-extdata asset, explicit cache/download policy, built-in 17-region ASEG metadata, FreeSurfer ColorLUT parser, provenance artifact/history, and loadFromPaths over AtlasLabelMaps. Added AsegLoaderSuite covering descriptor metadata, neuroatlas-compatible label rows, LUT parsing, synthetic NIfTI loadFromPaths filtering, and provenance. Updated atlas README and docs/plans/atlas.md. Verified with sbt atlasJVM/test atlasJS/test; live download not run.
